segs.utf8: Hi, it’s Shion.
Today is Wednesday, February 11th.

I just finished a video fan sign
and now I’m filming this video diary.

It feels like it’s been a while since I did a video diary.
You all missed me, right?
Tell me you missed me!
I think this is my first video diary since our comeback.
There’s so much I’ve been wanting to tell you lately.

Recently, we went to Daejeon
to film the bread tour episode of SIGNAL.
We often travel nearby for SIGNAL shoots,

but it was my first time going all the way to Daejeon,
and I was really surprised.

When I saw “Daejeon Bread Tour”
on the schedule,

the members and I thought it meant visiting
Seoul branches of bakeries originally from Daejeon.

But we actually got to visit Seongsimdang
and other famous local spots nearby.

I think Xinyu unnie and HaYeon were really satisfied
and had a lot of fun too.
It made me so happy to visit Daejeon for filming after such a long time.

While we were walking around the city,
“Firework Diary” started playing, even though it’s not the title track.

Out of nowhere, I heard the intro
of “Firework Diary” in front of a convenience store.

I was like, “Wait, what?” and totally shocked,
but also so grateful.
I honestly felt like it was fate. It was the best!

Also, the bread-themed live stream we did before
was such a meaningful time.

Lately, we’ve been filming a lot of bread-related content,
and it feels kind of surreal.

I almost couldn’t tell
if I was Park ShiOn or “Bread ShiOn.”

And recently, we’ve been working really hard
preparing for the concert.

Like the members mentioned,
this concert’s setlist is a bit different from before.

We’re putting together something even more special,
so please look forward to it.

I know WAV is really excited,
and we’ll work hard to live up to your expectations.
We’ll make sure to travel safely to and from the venue,
so WAV, please stay safe too.

It’s been really cold lately,
so be careful not to catch a cold or the flu, okay?

Also, we’ve been practicing as the moon unit again,
and it feels really fresh and fun.

The moon unit has such uniquely funny members
in the most unexpected ways.

So it’s a bit of a shame
that we can’t show that chemistry to WAV yet.
I’m sure you already know,

but there are so many times in the practice room
when I think, “I wish WAV could be here with us.”
As we prepare for the concert,

at first, it felt overwhelming
because there was so much to do.

But we want to bring everything to the best possible level
and show you an amazing stage.

I want this concert to be a performance
that makes your precious time truly worthwhile.
That’s it for today’s video diary.

Thank you so much to everyone who watched.
Bye!
